extraFacts.fact: Size ranges of the neighbouring Indus listings: Guardair Chicago couplers 1/2" and 3/4" (aluminium); Guardair universal couplers 1/4" and 3/8" (brass); Hansen universal quick coupler body 1/4" to 1/2" (brass and carbon steel, ball valve); Hansen Auto-Flo 23 coupler body 1/4" and 3/8" (brass, poppet valve).
extraFacts.source: Indus Hydraulics product listings for the universal air coupling shelf

extraFacts.fact: Quick couplings seal and flow at their rating only when both halves come from the same interchange profile; a profile such as Industrial (ARO 210), Truflate or Universal is named on the maker's pages and halves of different profiles do not mate.
extraFacts.source: Maker interchange profile convention (Hansen, Guardair catalogues as listed on the Indus product pages)

extraFacts.fact: A Chicago (claw) universal coupling is a symmetrical interlocking air coupling: both halves are identical, they are pushed together and twisted a quarter turn, and a safety pin or clip stops them backing off.
extraFacts.source: Indus guide: universal air couplings explained

faqs.q: What is the Dixon Air King 2-Lug Female NPT Ends and what is it used for?
faqs.a: The Dixon Air King 2-Lug Female NPT Ends are two-lug universal (Chicago-style) hose-end couplings with a female NPT thread, made by Dixon in iron, brass and 316 stainless steel with a rubber seal, in nine part numbers from 1/4" to 1". The supplied safety clip locks the coupling so the pin cannot pass until the lugs are engaged.

faqs.q: How do I choose between the Dixon Air King 2-Lug Female NPT Ends part numbers such as AM3, ABC1 and RAM3?
faqs.a: The rows show a pattern in the letters: part numbers starting AM are iron (AM3 is the 1/2" iron female NPT end), ABC1 is the 1/4" brass one, and RAM3 is the 1/2" 316 stainless steel one, so R marks stainless steel. The number is a size code, since AM3 is 1/2" and AM13 is 1".

faqs.q: What sizes do the Dixon Air King 2-Lug Female NPT Ends come in?
faqs.a: The Dixon Air King 2-Lug Female NPT Ends come in 1/4", 3/8", 1/2", 3/4" and 1" female NPT. Sizes 3/8", 1/2", 3/4" and 1" are listed in iron and in 316 stainless steel, and 1/4" is listed in brass.

faqs.q: Which Dixon Air King hose-end fittings go with the Dixon Air King 2-Lug Female NPT Ends?
faqs.a: The listing says the Dixon Air King 2-Lug Female NPT Ends are used with Air King ferrules, since the female NPT end threads onto a hose-end fitting or tool. See the [Dixon Air King couplings with ferrule](/p/dixon-air-king-couplings-with-ferrule) for the hose-side parts, and use the supplied safety clip on every joint.

faqs.q: What pressure are the Dixon Air King 2-Lug Female NPT Ends rated for?
faqs.a: Dixon states 145 to 150 psi (about 10 bar) for the Dixon Air King 2-Lug Female NPT Ends, by size: most rows carry 150 psi and the stainless steel RAM3 and RAMC rows carry 145 psi. These are compressed-air couplings, so keep your working pressure under the figure for the row you order.

faqs.q: What materials are the Dixon Air King 2-Lug Female NPT Ends made from?
faqs.a: The Dixon Air King 2-Lug Female NPT Ends are made in iron, brass or 316 stainless steel, with a rubber seal and a rubber washer (part AWR4) supplied. Choose 316 stainless steel for wet or corrosive sites and iron for general site air.

faqs.q: Do the Dixon Air King 2-Lug Female NPT Ends include a safety clip, and why does it matter?
faqs.a: Yes, the Dixon Air King 2-Lug Female NPT Ends are supplied with a safety clip. Dixon says the clip guarantees the fittings are properly connected, because the safety pin will not go through the holes in mating fittings until the couplings are locked in place.

faqs.q: What threads and mating halves do the Dixon Air King 2-Lug Female NPT Ends have?
faqs.a: The Dixon Air King 2-Lug Female NPT Ends have a female NPT thread on the hose-end side and a two-lug Chicago profile on the coupling side. They mate with another two-lug Chicago coupling, since both halves of a universal coupling are the same; see our [universal air coupling guide](/blog/universal-air-couplings-explained).

faqs.q: How should the Dixon Air King 2-Lug Female NPT Ends be installed?
faqs.a: Seal the NPT thread, fit the rubber washer in the coupling face, push the two halves together, twist a quarter turn and insert the safety clip. Inspect the washer and lugs at every make-up, because a worn lug or washer is what lets a coupling leak or release.

faqs.q: How do the Dixon Air King 2-Lug Female NPT Ends differ from the Air King couplings with ferrule?
faqs.a: The Dixon Air King 2-Lug Female NPT Ends have a female NPT thread and fit tools and pipework, while the [Dixon Air King couplings with ferrule](/p/dixon-air-king-couplings-with-ferrule) have a hose end clamped with a ferrule for 1/2" to 1" hose. Use the ferrule type to put a coupling on a hose and the female NPT type to put one on a threaded port.

faqs.q: What is the Dixon Air King Couplings With Ferrule and what is it used for?
faqs.a: The Dixon Air King Couplings With Ferrule are two-lug Chicago couplings with a hose barb, made by Dixon in iron or 316 stainless steel, that are clamped to the hose with a ferrule. The listing gives six part numbers in 1/2", 3/4" and 1" sizes, rated 145 psi (10 bar) by the maker.

faqs.q: How do I read the Dixon Air King Couplings With Ferrule part numbers such as AM6WF and RAM6WF?
faqs.a: On these rows the letters WF mean the coupling is supplied with a ferrule, AM marks an iron body and RAM a 316 stainless steel body: AM6WF and RAM6WF are both 3/4" and take 1-4/64 to 1-22/64 in hose O.D. The number is a size code, with 1 for 1/2", 6 for 3/4" and 11 for 1".

faqs.q: What hose outside diameters do the Dixon Air King Couplings With Ferrule fit?
faqs.a: Each part number fits a hose O.D. range: AM1WF takes 54/64 to 1-2/64 in, AM6WF takes 1-4/64 to 1-22/64 in, and AM11WF takes 1-30/64 to 1-46/64 in. Measure the outside diameter of your hose, since the ferrule is sized to it, and ask us if it falls between ranges.

faqs.q: Which sizes of the Dixon Air King Couplings With Ferrule are available in iron and stainless steel?
faqs.a: The Dixon Air King Couplings With Ferrule are listed in 1/2", 3/4" and 1" hose sizes. Iron versions are AM1WF, AM6WF, AM11WF and AM11WF-1, and the 316 stainless steel versions are RAM1WF and RAM6WF.

faqs.q: What pressure and temperature are the Dixon Air King Couplings With Ferrule rated for?
faqs.a: Dixon states 145 psi (10 bar) for the Dixon Air King Couplings With Ferrule, and the listing shows a temperature of 70°F. Use them on compressed-air hose rated at least that high and check the hose rating, since a joint is limited by its weakest part.

faqs.q: What are the Dixon Air King Couplings With Ferrule made of and how are they finished?
faqs.a: The Dixon Air King Couplings With Ferrule are iron or 316 stainless steel with a plated finish and a rubber seal. Choose stainless steel for wet, marine or corrosive sites and plated iron for general air lines.

faqs.q: Which hose can the Dixon Air King Couplings With Ferrule be fitted to?
faqs.a: The Dixon Air King Couplings With Ferrule are for air hose with an outside diameter that matches the ferrule range, for example 1-4/64 to 1-22/64 in on the 3/4" size. The listing names no hose standard, so quote the hose part number or its outside diameter when you order.

faqs.q: What do the Dixon Air King Couplings With Ferrule connect to?
faqs.a: The barbed hose end takes air hose held by a ferrule, and the two-lug Chicago end mates with another two-lug Chicago coupling, since both halves are the same. See the [Dixon Air King 2-lug female NPT ends](/p/dixon-air-king-2-lug-female-npt-ends) for the threaded side.

faqs.q: How are the Dixon Air King Couplings With Ferrule fitted to a hose?
faqs.a: Push the hose over the barb, slide the ferrule over the hose and crimp or swage it to the maker's instruction, then fit the rubber seal and the safety pin or clip. A ferrule that is the wrong size for the hose outside diameter will not hold, so check the O.D. range first.

faqs.q: How do the Dixon Air King Couplings With Ferrule differ from the Air King 2-lug female NPT ends?
faqs.a: The Dixon Air King Couplings With Ferrule are the hose-end type, clamped to hose with a ferrule, while the [Dixon Air King 2-lug female NPT ends](/p/dixon-air-king-2-lug-female-npt-ends) have a female NPT thread for tools and pipework. Use this listing to put a coupling on a hose.

faqs.q: Where are the Dixon Air King Couplings With Ferrule made?
faqs.a: The listing gives the United States as the country of origin for the Dixon Air King Couplings With Ferrule, and the maker is Dixon. We supply from Dubai, UAE and ship worldwide.

faqs.q: What is the Aeroquip 190772 Series Universals and what is it used for?
faqs.a: The Aeroquip 190772 Series Universals are reusable 90° elbow hydraulic hose fittings in carbon steel, from Eaton Aeroquip, with a female end on one side and a hose socket on the other. The listing has seven part numbers from 7/16" to 1-1/2", for the 2807, FC465 and S-TW hose series.

faqs.q: How do I read the part numbers of the Aeroquip 190772 Series Universals, such as 190772-8S and 190772-16S?
faqs.a: The number after 190772 is the hose dash size and the S marks the style: 190772-4S is 7/16", 190772-6S is 9/16", 190772-8S is 3/4", 190772-10S is 7/8" and 190772-16S is 1 5/16" on the female connection. Quote the hose series and dash size with the part number.

faqs.q: What sizes and end types do the Aeroquip 190772 Series Universals come in?
faqs.a: The Aeroquip 190772 Series Universals are listed from 7/16" to 1-1/2" in seven part numbers, with a universal female end on the smaller sizes (190772-4S, -5S, -8S, -10S) and a JIC female end on 190772-6S, -12S and -16S. Pick the part number whose end matches the mating thread.

faqs.q: Which hoses do the Aeroquip 190772 Series Universals fit?
faqs.a: The Aeroquip 190772 Series Universals are listed for 2807 series, SC-TW series and S-TW series hose, and for compatible hoses 2807, FC465 and S-TW. Match your hose to one of those series before ordering, since a reusable fitting fits only its own hose construction.

faqs.q: What pressure are the Aeroquip 190772 Series Universals rated for?
faqs.a: The listing gives no pressure rating for the Aeroquip 190772 Series Universals. A hose fitting is limited by the hose it is used with, so check the working pressure of the 2807, FC465 or S-TW hose and ask us for Eaton's fitting rating if your system runs near it.

faqs.q: What are the Aeroquip 190772 Series Universals made of and how are they plated?
faqs.a: The Aeroquip 190772 Series Universals are carbon steel, grade 12L14 or 12L15, with a Dura Kote finish listed as trivalent chromate zinc. The listing says they are reusable and need no thread sealant.

faqs.q: Are the Aeroquip 190772 Series Universals a reusable fitting, and what is the hose cut-off factor?
faqs.a: Yes, the Aeroquip 190772 Series Universals are a reusable (field-attachable) style, and the listing gives a hose cut-off factor of 2.49". Allow that figure when you cut the hose to length, so the assembly comes out at the length you need.

faqs.q: What do the Aeroquip 190772 Series Universals connect to?
faqs.a: The Aeroquip 190772 Series Universals have a female JIC or universal end for the mating port and a hose end for the hose, as a 90° elbow. Match the end to the mating male fitting.

faqs.q: How are the Aeroquip 190772 Series Universals assembled onto a hose?
faqs.a: Cut the hose square, allow the 2.49" cut-off factor, then fit the socket and nipple following Eaton's reusable-fitting procedure for the 2807, FC465 or S-TW hose. Do not reuse a fitting that has been damaged on the thread or seat.

faqs.q: How do the Aeroquip 190772 Series Universals differ from the Dixon Air King couplings?
faqs.a: The Aeroquip 190772 Series Universals are hydraulic hose fittings with JIC and universal female ends, whereas the [Dixon Air King couplings with ferrule](/p/dixon-air-king-couplings-with-ferrule) are two-lug Chicago air couplings. This listing sits on the universal air coupling shelf but is a hose fitting, so do not use it as an air coupling half.

faqs.q: What are the Guardair Chicago Couplers used for?
faqs.a: The Guardair Chicago Couplers are aluminium Chicago (Air King style) couplers from Guardair for compressed-air lines, in 1/2" and 3/4" NPT. The listing has four part numbers: N610, N647, 34AKM05 and the swivel version 34SAKM05.

faqs.q: How do I choose between the Guardair Chicago coupler part numbers N610, N647, 34AKM05 and 34SAKM05?
faqs.a: N610 is the 1/2" NPT Chicago coupler, N647 and 34AKM05 are 3/4" NPT Chicago couplers, and 34SAKM05 is the 3/4" NPT Chicago swivel coupler. The listing gives no decode for the codes, so quote the part number.

faqs.q: What sizes do the Guardair Chicago Couplers come in?
faqs.a: The Guardair Chicago Couplers come in 1/2" NPT (N610) and 3/4" NPT (N647, 34AKM05, 34SAKM05). All four are listed as female-half couplers.

faqs.q: What is the difference between 34AKM05 and 34SAKM05 on the Guardair Chicago Couplers?
faqs.a: 34SAKM05 is the swivel version of the 3/4" Chicago coupler, while 34AKM05 is the fixed one. A swivel lets the hose turn without twisting the coupling, which helps on hose that is dragged and twisted.

faqs.q: What pressure are the Guardair Chicago Couplers rated for?
faqs.a: The listing gives no pressure rating for the Guardair Chicago Couplers. They are aluminium air couplers, so ask us for Guardair's rating for your part number before use, and add a whip-check cable on higher-pressure air.

faqs.q: What are the Guardair Chicago Couplers made of?
faqs.a: The Guardair Chicago Couplers are made of aluminium, a lighter metal than steel. Aluminium is softer than steel, so inspect the lugs for wear more often on heavily used hose.

faqs.q: Do the Guardair Chicago Couplers follow a standard Chicago profile?
faqs.a: The listing calls them Chicago couplers, the claw-style universal air coupling, and the type is Air King fitting. No standard number is given, so confirm the mating coupler is the same Chicago (claw) type before ordering.

faqs.q: What do the Guardair Chicago Couplers connect to?
faqs.a: The Guardair Chicago Couplers have an NPT thread on one side and a Chicago claw profile on the other, and they mate with any Chicago coupling of the same style. Both halves are the same, so a Chicago coupler joins another Chicago coupler. See our [universal air coupling guide](/blog/universal-air-couplings-explained).

faqs.q: How should the Guardair Chicago Couplers be fitted?
faqs.a: Seal the NPT thread, fit the gasket, push the two halves together and twist a quarter turn, and lock them with a safety pin or clip. Inspect the lugs and gasket at every make-up.

faqs.q: How do the Guardair Chicago Couplers differ from the Guardair universal couplers?
faqs.a: The Guardair Chicago Couplers are the aluminium Chicago claw type in 1/2" and 3/4", while the [Guardair universal couplers](/p/guardair-universal-couplers) are brass quick couplers in 1/4" and 3/8". They are different profiles and will not mate.

faqs.q: Where are the Guardair Chicago Couplers made and what is their HS code?
faqs.a: The listing gives the United States as the country of origin for the Guardair Chicago Couplers, with HS code 8508700000. We supply from Dubai, UAE and ship worldwide.

faqs.q: Do you stock Guardair Chicago Couplers in Dubai for export?
faqs.a: Yes, Guardair Chicago Couplers are held in stock at our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and ship worldwide with the best lead times. Request a price and delivery date on [our contact page](/contact).

faqs.q: What are the Guardair Universal Couplers used for?
faqs.a: The Guardair Universal Couplers are brass quick couplers from Guardair for compressed-air lines, in 1/4" and 3/8" sizes with male or female NPT threads. The listing has six part numbers: C14U14F, C14U14M, C14U38F, C14U38M, C38U38F and C38U38M.

faqs.q: How do I read the part numbers of the Guardair Universal Couplers, such as C14U38F?
faqs.a: The rows show the pattern: C and the first number give the coupler size (14 is 1/4", 38 is 3/8"), U and the next number give the thread size, and the last letter gives the thread gender. C14U38F is a 1/4" coupler with a 3/8" female NPT thread, and C14U38M the same with a 3/8" male NPT thread.

faqs.q: What sizes do the Guardair Universal Couplers come in?
faqs.a: The Guardair Universal Couplers come in a 1/4" coupler size with 1/4" or 3/8" NPT threads, and a 3/8" coupler size with a 3/8" NPT thread, each in male and female versions, giving six part numbers.

faqs.q: What is the difference between the F and M part numbers on the Guardair Universal Couplers?
faqs.a: The final letter of each part number is the thread gender: F is a female NPT inlet and M is a male NPT. C14U14F takes a 1/4" female NPT, while C14U14M has a 1/4" male NPT, so choose by the thread on your hose fitting or tool.

faqs.q: What pressure are the Guardair Universal Couplers rated for?
faqs.a: The listing gives no pressure rating for the Guardair Universal Couplers. Ask us for Guardair's rating for your part number before use, and match it to the lowest-rated component in the air line.

faqs.q: What are the Guardair Universal Couplers made of?
faqs.a: The Guardair Universal Couplers are made of brass, which resists corrosion and suits general workshop air service. The listing gives no seal material, so ask us if you need it confirmed.

faqs.q: Which interchange profile do the Guardair Universal Couplers follow?
faqs.a: The listing calls them universal couplers and gives no interchange profile number, so confirm the mating plug before ordering. Quick couplings only seal and flow at their rating when both halves come from the same interchange profile.

faqs.q: What do the Guardair Universal Couplers connect to?
faqs.a: The Guardair Universal Couplers are coupler (female) halves with an NPT thread on the inlet side, and they mate with a plug of the same interchange profile. Quote the plug part number or tell us what it must connect to and we confirm the match.

faqs.q: How should the Guardair Universal Couplers be fitted?
faqs.a: Seal the NPT thread with a suitable sealant, tighten it into the hose fitting or tool port, and test the connection with the mating plug before you pressurise the line. Replace a coupler that leaks at the seal.

faqs.q: How do the Guardair Universal Couplers differ from the Guardair Chicago couplers?
faqs.a: The Guardair Universal Couplers are brass quick couplers in 1/4" and 3/8", while the [Guardair Chicago couplers](/p/guardair-chicago-couplers) are aluminium claw-type couplers in 1/2" and 3/4". They are different profiles and will not mate.

faqs.q: Where are the Guardair Universal Couplers made?

faqs.a: Yes. We keep Guardair Universal Couplers in stock at our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and ship worldwide with the best lead times. Send the part numbers and quantities through [our contact page](/contact) for a quotation.

faqs.q: What is the Hansen Auto-Flo 23 Universal Series Industrial, ARO210, Truflate Interchange Coupler Body used for?
faqs.a: The Hansen Auto-Flo 23 Universal Series Industrial, ARO210, Truflate Interchange Coupler Body is a brass quick coupler body (socket) with a poppet valve, made by Hansen for compressed-air lines, in 1/4" and 3/8" NPT sizes. It is zinc plated, push-to-connect, and works with the Industrial (ARO 210) and Truflate interchange profiles.

faqs.q: How do I read the part numbers of the Hansen Auto-Flo 23 Universal Series Industrial, ARO210, Truflate Interchange Coupler Body, such as B23AS25F and B23AS37H?
faqs.a: On these rows the last letter gives the end: F is a female NPT, M a male NPT and H a hose barb, and the two digits before it give the size, 25 for 1/4" and 37 for 3/8". B23AS25F is the 1/4" female NPT body and B23AS37H the 3/8" hose-barb body.

faqs.q: What sizes and end connections does the Hansen Auto-Flo 23 Universal Series Industrial, ARO210, Truflate Interchange Coupler Body come in?
faqs.a: The Hansen Auto-Flo 23 Universal Series Industrial, ARO210, Truflate Interchange Coupler Body is listed in 1/4" and 3/8" bodies, each with a female NPT, male NPT or hose barb end, six part numbers in all. Choose the end that matches the hose fitting, tool or pipe thread you are connecting.

faqs.q: What interchange profile does the Hansen Auto-Flo 23 Universal Series Industrial, ARO210, Truflate Interchange Coupler Body follow?
faqs.a: The Hansen Auto-Flo 23 Universal Series Industrial, ARO210, Truflate Interchange Coupler Body is listed for Industrial interchange (ARO 210) and Truflate, as the Auto-Flo 23 universal series. A coupler body only mates with a plug of the same profile, so match the plug before ordering; the listing's plug is the Hansen Auto-Flo 23 plug.

faqs.q: What temperature range is the Hansen Auto-Flo 23 Universal Series Industrial, ARO210, Truflate Interchange Coupler Body rated for?
faqs.a: The listing gives -40°F to +250°F for the Hansen Auto-Flo 23 Universal Series Industrial, ARO210, Truflate Interchange Coupler Body, with a nitrile seal. It states no pressure rating for this body, so ask us for Hansen's figure before use, and match the plug and hose ratings.

faqs.q: What is the Hansen Auto-Flo 23 Universal Series Industrial, ARO210, Truflate Interchange Coupler Body made of?
faqs.a: The Hansen Auto-Flo 23 Universal Series Industrial, ARO210, Truflate Interchange Coupler Body is made of brass with a zinc-plated finish and a nitrile seal. Nitrile suits compressed air and many oils but not every chemical, so tell us the medium if it is not air.

faqs.q: Does the Hansen Auto-Flo 23 Universal Series Industrial, ARO210, Truflate Interchange Coupler Body include a valve and how does it connect?
faqs.a: Yes, the Hansen Auto-Flo 23 Universal Series Industrial, ARO210, Truflate Interchange Coupler Body includes a poppet valve, so it shuts off flow when the plug is released, and it connects by push-to-connect locking. Plug and body must share an interchange profile for the valve to open and seal properly.

faqs.q: Which plug mates with the Hansen Auto-Flo 23 Universal Series Industrial, ARO210, Truflate Interchange Coupler Body?
faqs.a: The Hansen Auto-Flo 23 Universal Series Industrial, ARO210, Truflate Interchange Coupler Body mates with a plug of the same Industrial or Truflate profile, such as the [Hansen Auto-Flo 23 Truflate plug](/p/hansen-auto-flo-23-universal-series-truflate-interchange-coupler-plug). Quote the plug part number or tell us what it must connect to and we confirm the match.

faqs.q: How should the Hansen Auto-Flo 23 Universal Series Industrial, ARO210, Truflate Interchange Coupler Body be fitted?
faqs.a: Seal the NPT thread or fit the hose on the barb, connect the plug to confirm it locks and flows, and replace the body if the seal leaks. Keep the pressure within the rating of the lowest-rated part in the line.

faqs.q: How does the Hansen Auto-Flo 23 Universal Series Industrial, ARO210, Truflate Interchange Coupler Body differ from the Hansen universal quick coupler body?
faqs.a: This Auto-Flo 23 body has a poppet valve and is brass only, in 1/4" and 3/8". The [Hansen universal quick coupler body](/p/hansen-universal-quick-coupler-body) has a ball valve, brass and carbon steel bodies up to 1/2", and the Industrial profile only.

faqs.q: Where is the Hansen Auto-Flo 23 Universal Series Industrial, ARO210, Truflate Interchange Coupler Body made and what is its HS code?

faqs.q: What is the Hansen Auto-Flo 23 Universal Series Truflate Interchange Coupler Plug used for?

faqs.q: How do I read the part numbers of the Hansen Auto-Flo 23 Universal Series Truflate Interchange Coupler Plug, such as 21AP25F and 31AP37M?

faqs.q: What sizes and pressure ratings does the Hansen Auto-Flo 23 Universal Series Truflate Interchange Coupler Plug come in?

faqs.q: What is the difference between the F and M part numbers on the Hansen Auto-Flo 23 Universal Series Truflate Interchange Coupler Plug?

faqs.q: What pressure and temperature is the Hansen Auto-Flo 23 Universal Series Truflate Interchange Coupler Plug rated for?

faqs.q: What is the Hansen Auto-Flo 23 Universal Series Truflate Interchange Coupler Plug made of?
faqs.a: The Hansen Auto-Flo 23 Universal Series Truflate Interchange Coupler Plug is made of carbon steel with a zinc-plated finish and a nitrile seal. Nitrile suits compressed air and many oils but not every chemical, so tell us the medium if it is not air.

faqs.q: Which interchange profile does the Hansen Auto-Flo 23 Universal Series Truflate Interchange Coupler Plug follow?
faqs.a: The Hansen Auto-Flo 23 Universal Series Truflate Interchange Coupler Plug is listed for the Auto-Flo 23 series and Truflate, as a universal-interchange plug with a sleeve lock. A plug only seals and flows at its rating with a body of the same profile, so match the coupler body before you order.

faqs.q: Which coupler body mates with the Hansen Auto-Flo 23 Universal Series Truflate Interchange Coupler Plug?
faqs.a: The Hansen Auto-Flo 23 Universal Series Truflate Interchange Coupler Plug mates with a Truflate or Auto-Flo 23 coupler body, such as the [Hansen Auto-Flo 23 coupler body](/p/hansen-auto-flo-23-universal-series-industrial-aro210-truflate-interchange-coupler-body). The plug has no valve of its own, since the listing says a valve is not included.

faqs.q: How should the Hansen Auto-Flo 23 Universal Series Truflate Interchange Coupler Plug be fitted?
faqs.a: Seal the NPT thread, tighten the plug into the hose fitting or tool, then push it into the coupler body until the sleeve locks. Replace a plug whose seat is scored, since it will leak and can fail to lock.

faqs.q: How does the Hansen Auto-Flo 23 Universal Series Truflate Interchange Coupler Plug differ from the Hansen coupler body?
faqs.a: The plug is the male half in steel with a sleeve lock and no valve, rated 150 to 1,000 psi, while the [Hansen Auto-Flo 23 coupler body](/p/hansen-auto-flo-23-universal-series-industrial-aro210-truflate-interchange-coupler-body) is the brass socket half with a poppet valve. Use one of each to make a working connection.

faqs.q: What is the Hansen Universal Quick Coupler Body used for?
faqs.a: The Hansen Universal Quick Coupler Body is a quick-coupler body (socket) made by Hansen for the Industrial interchange profile, with a ball valve and sleeve lock, in brass or carbon steel from 1/4" to 1/2" NPT. The listing has 23 part numbers rated 250 to 2,000 psi by size.

faqs.q: How do I choose between the Hansen universal quick coupler body part numbers such as 1000E, 530E and 23204014?
faqs.a: The rows give each part number's end and size in the item text: 1000E is a 1/4" female NPT brass body, 530E a 1/2" male NPT brass body, 1600E a 1/4" hose-barb brass body, and 23204014 a 1/2" male NPT carbon steel body. The listing gives no decode, so use the item text.

faqs.q: What sizes and ends does the Hansen Universal Quick Coupler Body come in?
faqs.a: The Hansen Universal Quick Coupler Body is listed in 1/4", 3/8" and 1/2" bodies with female NPT, male NPT or hose-barb ends, 23 part numbers in brass and carbon steel. Choose the end to suit your hose fitting or tool thread.

faqs.q: What pressure rating goes with each size of the Hansen Universal Quick Coupler Body?
faqs.a: The rated pressure falls as the size grows: the brass 1/4" bodies are rated 2,000 psi, the 3/8" bodies 1,000 psi and the 1/2" bodies 500 psi, and the carbon steel bodies 250 psi. Use the row figure for your part number, and note that two rows carry no rating.

faqs.q: What is the pressure and temperature rating of the Hansen Universal Quick Coupler Body?
faqs.a: Hansen states 250 to 2,000 psi (17 to 138 bar) by size for the Hansen Universal Quick Coupler Body, with a temperature of -40°F to +250°F and a nitrile seal. Take the rating from the row for your part number and keep the plug and hose at least as high.

faqs.q: What is the Hansen Universal Quick Coupler Body made of?
faqs.a: The Hansen Universal Quick Coupler Body is made of brass or carbon steel with a nitrile seal and a ball valve. The listing shows silver and gold colours; check the body material of the part number you order, since the rows state it.

faqs.q: Which interchange profile does the Hansen Universal Quick Coupler Body follow?
faqs.a: The Hansen Universal Quick Coupler Body is listed for Industrial interchange, with a sleeve lock and a ball valve. A body only seals and flows at its rating with a plug of the same profile, so match the plug before ordering.

faqs.q: Which plug mates with the Hansen Universal Quick Coupler Body?
faqs.a: The Hansen Universal Quick Coupler Body mates with an Industrial-profile plug, but not with the Auto-Flo 23 Truflate plug in the [Hansen Auto-Flo 23 plug listing](/p/hansen-auto-flo-23-universal-series-truflate-interchange-coupler-plug) unless that profile matches. Quote the plug part number or tell us what it must connect to and we confirm the match.

faqs.q: How should the Hansen Universal Quick Coupler Body be fitted?
faqs.a: Seal the NPT thread or fit the hose on the barb, connect the plug to confirm it locks and flows, and keep the working pressure within the row rating. A scored seat or a leaking seal means the body should be replaced.

faqs.q: How does the Hansen Universal Quick Coupler Body differ from the Hansen Auto-Flo 23 coupler body?
faqs.a: This body has a ball valve, comes in brass and carbon steel up to 1/2" and is rated 250 to 2,000 psi, while the [Hansen Auto-Flo 23 coupler body](/p/hansen-auto-flo-23-universal-series-industrial-aro210-truflate-interchange-coupler-body) is brass only, in 1/4" and 3/8", with a poppet valve.
